name: DOGGO tax swapback fires on any sell with no slippage bound and can be sandwiched
summary: DOGGO's _transfer sells up to 4.2069e9 tokens of the contract's own balance into the Uniswap V2 pair with amountOutMin 0 whenever a transfer to the pair finds that balance above the 4.2069e9 threshold, and anyone can top the balance up by transferring to the contract. The attacker flash-borrowed 7.54e9 DOGGO from the Uniswap V3 pool, sold 1.98e9, donated 1.35e9 to the contract and sold 4.21e9 more, so the contract's 4.21e9 sale executed at the depressed price, then bought 7.62e9 back and kept 2.82 ETH.
notes: The contract's whole 2.85e9 DOGGO tax balance was sold for 18.50 ETH to the tax wallet; DOGGO has no price, so the loss is what the attacker realised (rule 12): 2.718 ETH to the sender plus a 0.106 ETH builder tip. The pair's net 21.33 ETH outflow is that sale and the attacker's round trip at constant product, not a loss to LPs.

Reset: the deployment three hours before the anchor. The owner's later trading switch only opened trading, and its limit removal was not needed: the attacker's 7.62e9 buy stayed under the original 8.41e9 max-transaction and wallet caps.
Campaign: no other transaction in which WETH both entered and left the pair also moved DOGGO out of the token contract; the later round trips by 0xae2fc483 are ordinary arbitrage.
